workflow_rationale: This is a multi-service feature adding client-side audio chunking, a new Cloud Function endpoint, real-time UI updates, and chunk stitching. It follows the feature workflow: backend API first (can be tested with curl), then frontend logic, then UI, then integration.

phases.name: Backend: transcribeChunk Endpoint & Text-Only Mode
phases.description: Create the new transcribeChunk Cloud Function for processing individual audio chunks with Gemini AI. Also extend the existing transcribe endpoint to accept a text field for post-processing stitched text without audio (needed for translate/clean/prompt modes on long recordings). Add firebase.json rewrite rule.

subtasks.description: Create the transcribeChunk Cloud Function endpoint in functions/index.js. This endpoint receives a single base64 audio chunk (~10 seconds), transcribes it with Gemini using a simplified raw-transcription-only prompt, and returns {text, language}. Uses the same verifyAuthToken(), generateContent(), and safeParseJson() patterns as the existing transcribe endpoint. Config: cors:true, maxInstances:20, invoker:public, timeoutSeconds:60, memory:256MiB.

verification.command: cd functions && node -e "const m = require('./index.js'); console.log(typeof m.transcribeChunk === 'function' ? 'OK' : 'MISSING')"

subtasks.notes: تم إضافة exports.transcribeChunk في functions/index.js (سطر 332). الـ endpoint بيستخدم نفس patterns الـ verifyAuthToken()، generateContent()، وـ safeParseJson(). Config: cors:true, maxInstances:20, invoker:public, timeoutSeconds:60, memory:256MiB. الـ verification اجت OK.

subtasks.description: Add text-only mode to the existing transcribe endpoint. When the request body contains a 'text' field (and no 'audio'), skip audio processing and run the text directly through the mode-specific prompt (translate/clean/prompt). This enables the two-phase flow for long recordings: phase 1 transcribes chunks individually via transcribeChunk, phase 2 sends the stitched text to /api/transcribe with mode and text fields for post-processing. Must remain backward-compatible — audio+mimeType requests work exactly as before.
patterns_from: functions/index.js (existing transcribe endpoint, prompt mode's two-step pattern)

verification.command: cd functions && node -e "const m = require('./index.js'); console.log(typeof m.transcribe === 'function' ? 'OK' : 'MISSING')"

subtasks.notes: تم إضافة text-only mode للـ transcribe endpoint في functions/index.js. لما يكون في `text` field من غير `audio` في الـ request body، الـ endpoint بيعمل post-processing على النص مباشرة حسب الـ mode: translate (text-to-text Arabic→English)، clean (تنظيف النص مع الحفاظ على اللهجة)، prompt (تحويل الكلام لـ AI prompt زي الـ step 2 الموجود)، وtranscribe (بيرجع النص زي ما هو من غير معالجة). Backward-compatible تماماً - requests الـ audio+mimeType شغالة زي الأول. Commit: 9f676c8.

subtasks.description: Add firebase.json rewrite rule mapping /api/transcribe-chunk to the transcribeChunk function. Follow the existing rewrite pattern.

verification.command: node -e "const f = require('./firebase.json'); const found = f.hosting.rewrites.some(r => r.source === '/api/transcribe-chunk' && r.function && r.function.functionId === 'transcribeChunk'); console.log(found ? 'OK' : 'MISSING')"

subtasks.notes: Added /api/transcribe-chunk rewrite rule pointing to transcribeChunk function in firebase.json. Follows exact same pattern as existing rules. Verification confirmed rule exists with correct source and functionId.

phases.name: Frontend: Streaming Recorder Core Logic
phases.description: Add the client-side streaming recorder logic to recorder.js. This includes text merging utilities (ported from cloud-recorder.js), the StreamingRecorder class with MediaRecorder rotation and overlap, and chunk HTTP send logic with retry support.

subtasks.description: Add text merging utilities to recorder.js: stripPunc() for punctuation removal, mergeOverlap(textA, textB) for overlap detection between adjacent chunks (up to 12 words), and mergeAllChunks(chunkResults) that iterates the sequence-indexed results array. These are ported from cloud-recorder.js with minor enhancements for Gemini output. Place them after the existing blobToBase64() function.

verification.instructions: Open browser console on app.html, verify stripPunc, mergeOverlap, mergeAllChunks functions exist in global scope. Test: mergeOverlap('hello world test', 'world test again') should return 'hello world test again'.

subtasks.notes: Added stripPunc(), mergeOverlap(), mergeAllChunks(chunkResults) after blobToBase64() in recorder.js. Ported from cloud-recorder.js with minor enhancements: stripPunc now also calls .toLowerCase() for case-insensitive Gemini output matching, and mergeAllChunks accepts chunkResults as a parameter instead of using a global variable. All verification tests passed including the required mergeOverlap('hello world test', 'world test again') === 'hello world test again' check.

subtasks.description: Add StreamingRecorder class to recorder.js. This class manages: (1) Starting chunked recording with MediaRecorder rotation every CHUNK_SECONDS (10s) with OVERLAP_MS (2000ms) overlap, (2) Sending each chunk blob as base64 via HTTP POST to /api/transcribe-chunk with auth token (fire-and-forget), (3) Collecting results into a sequence-indexed array with callback on each result, (4) Tracking chunk states (pending/sent/done/failed), (5) Retry logic for failed chunks (up to 3 retries with exponential backoff), (6) AbortController support for cancellation, (7) Memory management — release chunk blobs after successful upload. The class should expose: start(micStream), stop(), cancel(), onChunkResult callback, getStitchedText(), and status getters (totalChunks, completedChunks, failedChunks, isComplete). It reuses the shared micStream approach from cloud-recorder.js.
patterns_from: public/js/cloud-recorder.js (startNewRecorder, chunkInterval, sendChunk, fire-and-forget HTTP pattern)

verification.instructions: Open browser console on app.html, verify StreamingRecorder class exists. Verify: new StreamingRecorder() creates an instance with start, stop, cancel methods.

subtasks.notes: تم إضافة StreamingRecorder class كاملة لـ recorder.js (212 سطر جديد). الـ class بتتبع pattern الـ cloud-recorder.js بالظبط: MediaRecorder rotation مع OVERLAP_MS، fire-and-forget HTTP POST لـ /api/transcribe-chunk، retry logic مع exponential backoff (3 مرات)، AbortController للـ cancellation، memory management بـ blob nulling بعد الـ upload، وـ getStitchedText() بتستخدم mergeAllChunks() الموجودة في نفس الـ file.

Follow existing CSS patterns — use CSS custom properties, consistent border-radius, shadows.

Add a new updateStreamingCard(id, {completedChunks, totalChunks, partialText}) function for efficient live updates during streaming.

phases.name: Frontend: Wire Streaming into Recording Flow
phases.description: Integrate the StreamingRecorder into the main recording flow. Modify startRecording/stopRecording to use chunking, replace processAudio with a streaming-aware flow, extend QueueProcessor for two-phase processing, and handle edge cases.

subtasks.description: Modify startRecording() and stopRecording() in recorder.js to use StreamingRecorder. On startRecording(): create StreamingRecorder instance, acquire mic stream, start both the StreamingRecorder AND the original MediaRecorder (the original captures the full blob for single-chunk fallback). Set up onChunkResult callback to update the queue card with partial results. On stopRecording(): stop the StreamingRecorder and original MediaRecorder. Ensure the streaming recorder instance is stored so it's accessible from processAudio. Keep all existing functionality working — buttons, timer, wake lock, cancel.
subtasks.notes: تم تعديل startRecording() و stopRecording() في recorder.js. الـ changes: (1) إضافة 3 variables على مستوى الـ module: streamingRecorder, currentMicStream, streamingCardId. (2) startRecording(): بيحفظ الـ stream في currentMicStream، بيعمل StreamingRecorder جديد، بيربط onChunkResult callback يستدعي updateStreamingCard لما streamingCardId يكون موجود، بيـstart الـ StreamingRecorder على نفس الـ shared stream، وبيعمل original MediaRecorder للـ full-blob fallback. (3) stopRecording(): بيـcall cancel() لو recordingCancelled = true، أو stop() في الحالة العادية، وبيحتفظ بالـ reference عشان processAudio يقدر يقرأ totalChunks في subtask-4-2. الـ verification checklist: recording بيبدأ والـ timer بيشتغل ✓، recording بيوقف clean ✓، مفيش console errors ✓.

subtasks.description: Replace processAudio() with a streaming-aware flow. Decision logic: if StreamingRecorder produced only 1 chunk (short recording, typically < 12s), use the existing single-request flow to /api/transcribe (backward compatible). If multiple chunks were produced, create a streaming queue record with isStreaming:true and status:'streaming', add it to the queue, and let the StreamingRecorder's results flow into the card. When all chunks complete, set status to 'stitching' if mode is translate/clean/prompt (need post-processing), or 'done' if mode is transcribe. For stitching: send the stitched text to /api/transcribe with {text, mode} for post-processing, then update card to 'done'. Handle errors gracefully — if post-processing fails, still show the raw stitched text with an option to retry post-processing.

checks: Long recording creates streaming queue card
Queue card shows partial results during recording

subtasks.notes: Implemented streaming-aware processAudio() flow. Short recordings (totalChunks <= 1) use backward-compatible single-request flow. Long recordings create streaming queue card via processStreamingAudio(), wire onChunkResult for live progress updates, use 500ms poller for silent chunk settlements, then call handleStreamingComplete() which handles transcribe (done immediately) vs translate/clean/prompt (stitching phase via /api/transcribe text-only). Post-processing failures preserve raw stitched text with retryPostProcessing() and Retry button in UI. cancelStreamingRecording() handles mid-stream cancellation. restoreQueue() resets streaming/stitching items to failed on page reload.

subtasks.description: Handle remaining edge cases and robustness: (1) Cancel during streaming — cancelRecording() should call StreamingRecorder.cancel() which aborts all in-flight fetch requests, stops all recorders, releases mic stream, removes the queue card, (2) Network recovery — StreamingRecorder retry logic handles individual chunk failures with exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s), (3) restoreQueue() handling — on page reload, streaming items in IndexedDB should be restored. Items with status 'streaming' should become 'failed' (chunks are lost). Items with status 'stitching' should retry the stitching step. Items with status 'done' or 'failed' work as before, (4) Memory management — verify chunk blobs are released after base64 conversion and successful upload, (5) Very short recordings (< 1000 bytes) still bypass everything (existing check), (6) All empty chunks — display 'No speech detected' as current behavior, (7) Auto-save integration — streaming items that complete should auto-save if toggle is enabled.

checks: Cancel button stops recording and aborts in-flight requests

subtasks.notes: Implemented 3 key changes: (1) handleStreamingComplete now saves stitchedText to IndexedDB when transitioning to 'stitching' status, enabling reliable page-reload recovery. (2) Added retryStitching() function that retries post-processing for recovered stitching items with auto-save integration and postProcessFailed fallback. (3) Fixed restoreQueue() to treat streaming items as failed (chunks lost) and stitching items as retriable instead of both being failed. All other edge cases (cancel, retry backoff, memory, short recordings, auto-save) were already correctly implemented in previous subtasks.

phases.name: Integration: End-to-End Verification
phases.description: Wire all services together and verify end-to-end flows across all recording modes, durations, and edge cases. Verify backward compatibility with short recordings.

subtasks.description: End-to-end verification of the complete streaming flow: (1) Short recording (< 12s) — verify it uses the existing single-request flow, queue card appears normally, result is correct, (2) Long recording (1+ min) — verify chunks are sent, partial results appear in queue card, final stitched text is coherent, (3) All four modes with long recording — transcribe (raw text), translate (stitched → translated), prompt (stitched → prompt), clean (stitched → cleaned), (4) Cancel during streaming — verify cleanup, (5) Save/copy/edit after streaming — verify all actions work on stitched result, (6) Auto-save with streaming — verify auto-save fires after streaming completion, (7) Mobile layout — verify streaming UI fits in mobile viewport. Fix any issues found during testing.

steps: Start recording, speak for 8 seconds, stop → single-request flow, correct result
Start recording, speak for 1+ minutes, stop → streaming progress visible, stitched result appears
Record 1+ min with translate mode → raw chunks transcribed, stitched text translated to English
Record 1+ min with clean mode → raw chunks transcribed, stitched text cleaned
Cancel during 30s recording → in-flight requests aborted, queue card removed
Complete streaming → expand card, click Copy → text copied
Complete streaming → click Save → saved to Firestore with standard fields
Enable auto-save → complete streaming → auto-saved without manual action
Check mobile viewport (375px) → streaming UI renders correctly

subtasks.notes: End-to-end verification مكتمل. وجدنا واتنين bugs وفيخنا هم: (1) CSS layout bug - .queue-streaming-progress كانت display:flex بدون flex-direction:column، فالـ counter text والـ progress bar والـ partial text كانوا بيوقفوا جنب بعض (row) بدل ما يستاكلوا (column). Fix: أضفنا flex-direction:column + align-items:stretch. (2) UX bug - streaming items اللي فشلوا كانوا بيعرضوا Retry button لكن audioBlob=null فالـ retry بتكسر. Fix: أضفنا guard canRetry = !item.isStreaming. Verification: transcribeChunk endpoint ✓، text-only mode ✓، firebase.json rewrite ✓، StreamingRecorder (AbortController, memory management, exponential backoff) ✓، short recording bypass ✓، auto-save integration ✓، restoreQueue (streaming→failed, stitching→retry) ✓، مفيش console.log ✓.
